title: Factorized width x depth Mirror address
hypothesis: An additive width-factor plus depth-factor Givens address transfers to unseen joint width/depth configurations with near-independent quality and lower actual bytes than per-configuration maps.
mirror_coordinate: theta(width,depth)=alpha_width+beta_depth, stored as two small factor vectors
logical_multiplicity: Nine width x depth configurations with four joint combinations held out
controls: generic direct additive scalar law alpha_width+beta_depth applied as a Givens angle
independent effective output map per configuration

storage.authority: actual serialized NPZ inference payload bytes

success_gate: Across all fresh worlds, Mirror heldout NRMSE <=1e-4, <=50% bytes of independent maps, and >=10% smaller payload than generic additive scalar control at comparable quality.
failure_gate: Mirror misses quality/storage gate or generic additive scalar control reproduces its outputs and uses equal/lower bytes.
boundaries: Synthetic additive Givens-orbit mechanism only; no trained OFA/US-Net, natural task, GPU, or capacity evidence.
The generic additive scalar control is an explicit functional alias audit: exact function equality counts against Mirror-specificity.
